sample.high_low: Retrospective maxima and minima, not known at knee crossing

definitions.holdout: For each episode, exclude all episodes with same ticker, fit step mean then exponentiate

observed.interpretation_bootstrap: Resampling selected firms describes observed sample stability only; not a population confidence interval

cross_validation.unit: episode, but all same-ticker episodes removed from training
cross_validation.loss: absolute log ratio of predicted total cycle R to retrospective total cycle R
limitations: Uses ex-post finished cycles; no knee-cross event, no real-time upper band labels; not trading strategy validation
No free parameters beyond pre-declared 5,7,phi powers, median
Fixed Fibonacci integer n=5 or 7 is a test of an explicit narrow hypothesis, not all possible Fibonacci algorithms
Selection and data-quality bias from 46 candidates; only 30 passed archived price audits
Geometric segment model assumes log price scaling; arithmetic price segmentation is a separate research branch
Fibonacci ratio φ need not be 1 interval; cannot negate undisclosed original n-th function formula from these comparisons

interpretation: Linear 5-segment adjacent arithmetic ratio mean is visually closer to phi than log case, but stage ratios within each stock are unequal so raising this average to 5th power is not a valid linear price-grid forecast.
Company-bootstrap descriptive band spans phi, so this cohort cannot exclude phi for mean of linear adjacent ratios; proximity does not establish original Fibonacci formula.
Arithmetic average of linear level prices is identical for 5 and 7 due midpoint identity.
The firm-holdout peak projection metrics in this JSON apply ONLY to log/geometric segment multiplier, not linear adjacent arithmetic ratio.
